documents.abstract: This companion to FRC 100.006 v2.0 formally retires the underived 2025 [10^-4, 10^-3] Born-rule deviation heuristic and replaces it with exact, reproducible forward diagnostic bounds and explicitly conditional exclusion criteria for the three operational non-equilibrium mechanisms on the S^1 Fokker-Planck generator. documents.title: Born-Rule Equilibrium, Coherence Landscapes, and the Admissibility Gates for Resonant Relaxation
documents.abstract: This paper upgrades FRC 100.006 to a rigorously scoped conditional equilibrium framework for Born-rule statistics on a one-dimensional microstate phase circle S^1. Dividing the problem into a proven conditional core (Half A) and explicit open admissibility gates (Half B), we first prove three exact mathematical results for overdamped Langevin and Fokker-Planck dynamics on S^1 driven by a multi-basin coherence landscape C(phi; alpha, beta) = sum_j |alpha_j|^2 exp(beta cos(phi - phi_j)) with potential Lambda(phi) = Lambda_0 ln C(phi) and Einstein-scaled diffusivity D = k*/eta: (1) unique zero-current stationary equilibrium rho*_gamma(phi) = Z^{-1} C(phi)^gamma with exponent ratio gamma = Lambda_0 / k*; (2) an exact relative-entropy (KL) H-theorem with strict dissipation dH/dt = -D int rho |d_phi ln(rho/rho*_gamma)|^2 d phi <= 0 and explicit Holley-Stroock Log-Sobolev exponential convergence; and (3) an exact exponent-uniqueness theorem with certified non-asymptotic finite-beta overlap bounds showing that basin occupancies converge to p_j*(gamma) = |alpha_j|^{2 gamma} / sum_l |alpha_l|^{2 gamma} as beta -> infinity, uniquely selecting gamma = 1 (Lambda_0 = k*) for linear Born ratios while producing sharp power-law distortion for gamma != 1. A contrasting exact two-basin calculation proves that nonzero stochastic diffusion (D > 0) is mathematically indispensable: deterministic (D = 0) gradient capture from a uniform phase prior converges to 1/2 rather than |alpha_1|^2. Second, we synthesize two carrier-level obstructions from the hardened FRC corpus: FRC 100.007 v3.3 excludes audited deterministic rho-level Lambda-drifts via population drift (0.09 alpha to 0.22 alpha) and preparation-dependence slope 8.804, while FRC 830.005 v0.3 excludes every affine Bloch-ball map (hence every CPTP qubit channel) on open coherent sets while leaving one-dimensional circle fibers and outcome-conditioned instruments open, matching the S^1 microstate geometry. Finally, we state Half B transparently without circularity: Half A does not explain why the coupled system-apparatus landscape carries quadratic |alpha_j|^2 weights with Lambda_0 = k*, nor does it establish operational equivalence, bipartite no-signaling, or closed environment entropy accounting. All underived 2025 magnitude heuristics (including the prior [10^-4, 10^-3] guess) are formally retired.

The paper addresses five core foundational challenges—the hard problem and coupling ontology, determinism versus openness and agency, physical measurement versus experience, falsifiability boundaries and the one-way evidence valve, and tiered defeat conditions specifying what would genuinely falsify the bridge.

documents.abstract: FRC 566.030 applies the canonical reciprocity law dS + k* d ln C = 0 through one explicit information-unit realization. This stationary point is dQ=0; it is not sigma_566=0 unless an explicit environment model supplies that additional equality. The family contains no bath and therefore measures neither irreversible production nor entropy export. documents.abstract: FRC has an exact normalized entropy-coherence ledger involution D(x,y)=(-y,-x), a typed category of operational registers, and exact one-parameter and qubit lift obstructions. This paper asks whether those structures constitute quantum Born reciprocity or Majid-style representation-theoretic self-duality. They do not. The canonical Born exchange B_a(q,p)=(ap,-q/a) has order four and is symplectic, whereas D has order two and reverses the ambient area form; their different orders prevent conjugacy by any bijection. More decisively, the ledger datum does not reconstruct a unique state-space action, and this non-reconstruction occurs naturally in qubit fibers. A primitive Hopf algebraization makes pullback along D only a Hopf automorphism of one chosen ambient coordinate algebra, supplying neither an independently defined dual object nor a Hopf pairing, semidualisation, representation exchange, or physical state-observable map. Every C^1 one-parameter family with strictly monotone coherence and slope ds/dy < 1 (in particular the decreasing-entropy trade regime ds/dy < 0) excludes nonidentity lifts, and the threshold ds/dy = 1 is sharp. On the full qubit ledger, incoherent operations, unital channels, and Wigner symmetries fail on their stated domains, and an open-set rigidity theorem excludes every affine map of the Bloch ball—hence every CPTP qubit channel (unital or nonunital), every positive trace-preserving map, and every fixed-ancilla Stinespring protocol—from inducing D on any nonempty open subset with nonzero off-diagonal coherence. Explicit one-dimensional circle realizations show that the open-set hypothesis is sharp, leaving empty-interior subsets, projective outcome-conditioned instrument maps, higher-dimensional registers, and cross-register constructions open. Present FRC therefore possesses exact coordinate geometry, typed-morphism criteria, and sharp obstruction theorems, but not Born reciprocity or Majid-style self-duality.

documents.title: The Mind in the Coupling: A Philosophy of Cognition Without a Center
documents.abstract: Mind is not a substance but a phase a flow enters when it loops richly, holds its basins, and stays open far from rest; cognition lives in the coupling, not the unit, and minds nest inside minds. From the four conditions that turn a current into a cognizer to the fork between the anchored coupling that resolves the world and the adrift one that resolves only its own echo, this companion to The Open System relocates the mind out of the skull and into the between.

documents.title: The Open System (The Unclosed): A Philosophy of the Open System
documents.abstract: There are no closed systems and no true rest — every wall leaks, and the deepest law forbids perfect stillness. A thing is not an object but a held shape in flow, a process wearing the mask of a thing. This philosophical work asks how mind, persistence, and meaning may be read within that openness while leaving physical claims to the status-labeled papers.
